# QR code libraries (vendored, unmodified)

- `qrcode.js` — QR Code Generator for JavaScript 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence (see the file header). Draws the asset QR codes.
- `jsQR.js` — jsQR 1.4.0 by Cosmo Wolfe, Apache License 2.0 (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR). Reads QR codes from the camera or a photo when the browser has no built-in QR reader. Loaded only when scanning.

Both run entirely in the browser; neither makes network requests.
